scope: Reachable core Study UI dictionary fallbacks for isiZulu, Sesotho, Tshivenda and Xitsonga. Excludes design/finance reserve preview cards and general app guides. No translation wording proposed. Farm Finance/Design reserve previews and app guides excluded. Shared app header chrome is outside these page/player-owned files. The dictionary inventory includes main learner states and expanded lesson controls.

Each row has exact English dictionary source, source file/line and reachability condition. Targets are current on-disk locale dictionaries; absent locale key resolves to English through lib/i18n.tsx.

semantics.condition: Only show narration labels when the existing module/lesson has a narration track. Regional playback may offer compatible optional English narration; a learner without own-language narration starts with no narration selected and no playback until an explicit voice choice and Play action.

Only promise media in a pack when that media exists in the current pack inventory. Preserve slides-only as an available choice and state that it has no narration/video; full-media option must say available English source media, not imply translated or universally available narration.

semanticDependencies.source: {count} slides, narrated. Nothing downloads until you press play.
semanticDependencies.condition: Under hasDeck(moduleId), before deckOpen; this label is not gated by hasNarration(mod.id). Any later localization must preserve a true narration claim or this source-level dependency must be resolved.

requiresExplicitNarrationChoice and available tracks select default narration; when own-language narration is absent, default is NO_NARRATION and English source must not start without an explicit choice.

defaultOfflinePackVariant establishes the initial pack selection; regional choice appears only when regionalPackNeedsNarrationChoice, packs are built from actual offlinePack entries, and full-media claims must stay limited to assets actually present.
English fallback notice only when hasEnglishMedia; variant selects whether it describes slides or full media. Slides-only text explicitly promises no narration/video.

limits: Static source and dictionary reachability only; no phone/render inspection.
Rows in app/student/page.tsx can additionally depend on role, module unlock/progress, assignment state, media readiness or learner action; those are stated as conditions per group.
No fluent, farming, legal or financial approval claimed.

Current ordinary English in app-level helper outputs and fixed status text is reported separately from missing dictionary targets; exact-English source/status labels are retained as semantic controls.

conditionalExclusions.reason: Language-named notice keys are counted only for the corresponding explicit `lang ===` UI branch; they are not treated as missing in the other three languages.
Farm Finance/Design reserve preview cards and general app-guide/tour copy are outside the requested core Study UI scope.

IsiZulu-only due/unlock dictionary lookups are not counted as locale-key fallbacks for Sesotho/Tshivenda/Xitsonga; actual raw English returned by the helper is listed separately in runtimeRawEnglishRows.
The studentAudio lookup is not evaluated for ST/TS/VE; those branches render the explicit hardcoded `Audio: optional English` label instead.

Resolved through CATEGORY_LABEL_KEYS at the real call sites; retained only for VE/TS because their locale dictionaries lack this key. It can render for the actual business-category module in locked cards, and for unlocked cards outside Simple mode.

countDefinitions.sourcebound: A reachable literal UI key with a current explicit non-English target value in that locale file. This describes current binding, not language quality or approval.
countDefinitions.englishRetained: A reachable key with an explicit locale value exactly equal to the English source; retained source/status text, not counted as an unresolved dictionary fallback.
countDefinitions.unresolvedFallback: A reachable core UI key absent from the locale dictionary; lib/i18n.tsx returns the exact English source.
countDefinitions.rawEnglishRuntime: A raw English helper return path, outside a locale key lookup, included separately where actually reachable.
